release_summary: Initial sanitized guardrail contract for Terraform review.

controls.title: Use protected remote state
controls.requirement: Use Azure Storage remote state with Entra authorization, a nested key, and network restrictions.

controls.title: Use workload identity federation
controls.requirement: Use OIDC federation and separate plan and apply identities.

controls.title: Keep AI review advisory
controls.requirement: Deterministic checks and human approval remain authoritative for merge and apply.

adrs.title: Git is the canonical guardrail source
adrs.decision: Publish reviewed, tagged guardrail artifacts from Git. The MCP runtime serves a pinned release and is never edited directly.

terraform: Confirm formatting, validation, security scanning, and policy tests pass.
Confirm the backend key is nested and no Terraform workspace is selected.
Confirm the plan identity is read-only and apply requires human approval.
Confirm the plan contains no unexpected destroy or replacement.
Confirm no secrets or sensitive state values appear in comments or artifacts.
networking: Confirm public network access follows the approved exception process.
Confirm private DNS and endpoint reachability are tested from the runner subnet.
Confirm route and firewall changes preserve symmetric traffic flow.
